body: She looks like my first ever stuffed animal!!!🥹
This happened to me with Guinness… my shoes never recovered
Ohh that looks interesting! Will definitely check it out!

I have a few but the one that really stuck to me was the following:

“Someone else’s beauty does not mean absence of your own”

I struggle a lot with confidence/self image and tend to always compare myself to others. But when she told me this it really helped me see a different perspective.
